Selective Androgen Receptor Modulators (SARMs) are a class of therapeutic compounds designed to have selective anabolic effects on muscle and bone with reduced androgenic effects on other tissues. Unlike anabolic steroids, which are steroidal in structure, SARMs are non-steroidal. They bind to androgen receptors and act as agonists, mimicking the effects of natural androgens like testosterone in specific tissues, rather than inhibiting them.
